response.text: {"verdict": "not_covered", "clause_ids": ["A5.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves treatment for unstable angina, which is a pre-existing condition (arterial hypertension treated since 2024 and prior cardiology check-up for chest pain). Clause A5.1 explicitly excludes coverage for costs related to the treatment of a pre-existing health condition or its complications. The evidence indicates that the condition was not acute or related to an injury during the trip, but rather a continuation of a pre-existing condition."}
